events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) sets the pick on Moody (GSW) and rolls to the basket.
Butler III (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Wembanyama (SAS) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Fox (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Moody (GSW) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Vassell (SAS) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Fox (SAS) dislodges Butler III (GSW) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Champagnie (SAS) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to Warriors (GSW).
During the inbound pass, Butler III (GSW) immediately slides his hand off of Fox's (SAS) side and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Green (GSW) and Wembanyama (SAS) briefly engage and disengage off-ball, and the contact is marginal.
Butler III (GSW) is already in Fox's (SAS) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Castle (SAS) rotates over and makes marginal contact with Butler III's (GSW) arm during his shot attempt near the rim.

Wembanyama (SAS) contests Butler III's (GSW) shot near the rim and makes clean hand on ball contact dislodging the ball from Butler's possession. Any contact that occurs after the shot was blocked would be considered incidental.
Fox (SAS) brings his off-arm toward Moody's (GSW) side and marginal contact occurs as Fox attempts to dribble around Moody during the drive.
Fox (SAS) moves into and makes contact with Curry's (GSW) body during his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Payton II (GSW) legally contests Fox's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Any contact by Moody (GSW) that would impede Castle's (SAS) ability to get to the rebound occurs after the expiration of the game clock.
